about: Groundwork work plan. Rolling wave: only the current ring is broken into items. Change status and evidence only, through scripts/agent/plan.py. See PROCESS.md.

items.title: Matt approves creating the public GitHub repo mrwatts88/groundwork
items.instructions: Say yes in a session. Creating a GitHub repo is outward-facing, so it waits for your OK.
acceptance: Matt has said yes in a session, recorded in plan/PROGRESS.md

acceptance: gh repo view mrwatts88/groundwork --json visibility -q .visibility prints PUBLIC

Two earlier verifier FAILs were on the email before D-011 was recorded and confirmed.

items.title: pnpm workspace scaffold: protocol, sim, minds, server, client packages, TypeScript strict, Vitest, check-fast wired
acceptance: ls packages prints client minds protocol server sim
every package tsconfig extends a root tsconfig with strict true
pnpm -s typecheck exits 0 and pnpm -s test runs at least one test per package and exits 0
make check-fast prints check-fast: ok and its output shows the typecheck and vitest runs
introducing a type error in packages/sim makes make check-fast exit non-zero (verifier tries it on a scratch copy or reverts it)
README.md and docs/dev.md exist and say how to install and run the checks
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-03. ls packages prints client minds protocol server sim. Every package tsconfig extends tsconfig.base.json (strict true). pnpm -s typecheck exit 0, pnpm -s test 5 files 6 tests exit 0, one or more per package. make check-fast shows typecheck and vitest runs and check-fast: ok. A sim type error made check-fast exit 2 (TS2322) on a scratch copy. README.md and docs/dev.md give install and check steps.

items.title: Sim core: seeded map generation, tick, seeded RNG, the command API apply(state, command), one command (place_road), state hash
acceptance: a Vitest determinism test advances a 128x128 seeded world 10000 ticks with a scripted command log twice and gets the same state hash
the same test run in two separate processes prints the same hash (a test:slow script or a small CLI the verifier runs twice)
a test rejects an invalid place_road (out of bounds, on water, on a parcel the Op does not own) with a typed error and leaves the state hash unchanged
a test in packages/sim fails if any source file under packages/sim/src contains Math.random, Date or performance.now
map generation from the same seed produces the same terrain and different seeds produce different terrain (tests)
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-04. vitest 10000-tick 128x128 determinism test passes (same hash twice, changed log differs, split run matches). pnpm test:slow: two node processes print hash=659408debd1ae3d5, determinism ok. apply.test.ts: out_of_bounds, on_water, not_owner and others are typed errors with the hash unchanged. purity.test.ts passes and catches a planted Date. Mapgen: same seed gives identical terrain and 5 seeds give 5 distinct terrains. check-fast green, 25 tests.

items.title: Server: clock (present, speed-up, away), WebSocket state and commands, SQLite snapshot plus command log, resume after restart, /health
acceptance: an integration test starts the server with a fast clock, connects a WebSocket client, receives the initial state and tick updates
the test sends place_road over the WebSocket and sees it in the next state, and an invalid command returns an error message
the test stops the server, starts it again on the same data dir, and the road is still there and the tick count continues from where it stopped
GET /health returns JSON with tick, game date, clock mode and connected client count
a test shows the clock switches to away mode after the configured idle time with no client input, and back on input
clock rates and the data dir come from config, with defaults matching DESIGN.md 11.1
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-05. Real server plus ws client: welcome and consecutive ticks, place_road in the next delta, already_road, out_of_bounds and malformed frames return errors, a restart on the same dir keeps the tick and hash (also across snapshots), /health has tick, date, clock and clients, away after idle and back on input, config defaults match 11.1, check-fast 44 tests green

items.title: Client: Vite + PixiJS isometric map from server state, pan and zoom, click to place a road, HUD with date and clock speed

Playwright smoke 2 passed: canvas drawn, 1-map.png shows isometric map with water, grass, forest, hills, rock and deposits, click in road mode puts a road in 3-road.png (pixel diff) and in server state (road[i] != 0, cash 10000 to 9990), HUD date matches Day N, HH:MM and advances, speed reads 1x live and 4x sped up, GET / and /health on one port. make check-fast ok, 55 tests.

items.title: Minds skeleton: Mind interface, fake backend, claude -p backend, schema-validated output, budget governor counting calls
acceptance: unit tests cover the fake backend replaying a recorded reply by prompt hash and returning schema-valid output

unit tests cover the claude -p backend against a stubbed process: it builds the exact flags in DESIGN.md 13.4, runs in an empty working dir, parses structured_output, and rejects malformed or schema-invalid output with a typed error
a unit test shows the governor refuses or defers calls past the per-hour limit and lets a conversation call through within its own limit
every call records a usage row (agent, backend, model, tokens, ms, ok) through an injected recorder
no test spawns the real claude binary (verifier greps the tests and runs them with claude off the PATH)
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-07. fake replays by prompt hash with schema-valid output; claude -p backend tested on a stubbed process (exact 13.4 argv, empty temp cwd, structured_output, typed errors); governor defers or refuses past 120/h, conversation within its own limit; usage rows on every backend call through an injected recorder; 81/81 tests with claude off PATH; check-fast ok

items.title: Deploy: scripts/deploy.sh, systemd user service on the Fedora box, nightly SQLite backup timer
acceptance: scripts/deploy.sh run on the Mac pulls, installs, builds and restarts the service on the Fedora box, then prints the health JSON
curl -s http://laptop.local:7400/health from the Mac returns JSON with a tick that increases over 10 seconds
after ssh laptop 'systemctl --user restart groundwork', the tick resumes at or above its value before the restart
systemctl --user is-enabled groundwork prints enabled, and the backup timer is listed by systemctl --user list-timers
running the backup service once writes a copy to ~/groundwork-backups/ and keeps at most 14
docs/dev.md has a Deploy section
items.evidence: verifier: PASS R0-09. deploy.sh pushed, pulled, installed, built, restarted and printed health (tick 6). From the Mac, health tick went 6 to 7 and 7 to 8 over 10s. A restart resumed at tick 9 and reached 10 twelve seconds later. is-enabled printed enabled and the backup timer is listed. The backup service wrote a copy to ~/groundwork-backups, and retention left exactly 14 in a seeded temp dir. docs/dev.md has a Deploy section. check-fast is green, 81/81.

a test shows every tile owner resolves through one lookup in packages/sim to a party: frontier, an Op, the town or a named person (the person kind may have no members until R1-02)
a test shows toSnapshot and fromSnapshot round-trip the town and the party data, and the 10000-tick determinism test passes and pnpm test:slow prints the same hash in two processes

a test shows stake_claim is rejected with a typed error on water, on owned land, on a tile someone else is surveying, off the map and without the cash, each leaving the state hash unchanged

items.title: Depot: the first building, with construction time and staffing
acceptance: a sim test shows place_building with kind depot, on a dry tile the Op owns next to a road, charges its cash cost (a hiring cost included) and attention, stays under construction for its build time, then becomes active

a test shows place_building is rejected with typed errors when the tile is not the Op's, has no adjacent road, is water, is already built on, or the Op lacks cash or attention, each leaving the hash unchanged
a test shows an active depot pays its daily wage once per game day, an Op that cannot pay has the depot unstaffed and idle, it is staffed again once the Op can pay, and no Op's cash ever goes below 0
buildings are in the snapshot, the hash and the tick delta (tests), and the determinism tests and pnpm test:slow still match

#sidebar has a Depot tool. The Playwright smoke places a depot next to a road and saves screenshots of it under construction and built, with its own silhouette (verifier opens them), and #inspector shows its state
README How to play says how to build a depot and what it costs to run

items.title: Vehicles and the harvester route: deposit to depot on roads
acceptance: a sim test shows buy_vehicle with kind harvester at an active depot the Op owns charges its cost and attention and puts the harvester on the depot tile

a test shows set_route sends a harvester between a deposit tile the Op owns and its depot: it moves along road tiles by a deterministic shortest path (it may step onto its own deposit and depot tiles), mines ore at the deposit, lowering its richness, then returns and unloads into the depot's ore stock
set_route is rejected with no_path when no road path exists, and with typed errors for a deposit the Op does not own or a vehicle that is not its own (tests)
a scenario test in packages/sim: a harvester on a deposit 20 road tiles from its depot delivers ore to the depot within 2 game days (DESIGN.md 17)
a test shows a deposit mined down to 0 richness stops yielding and its harvester waits at the depot
vehicles, their cargo and depot stock are in the snapshot, hash and delta, and the determinism tests and pnpm test:slow still match

items.title: The town market, trucks and the cash ledger
acceptance: a sim test shows the town market holds an ore stock, a daily demand and a price, and every game hour the price rises when stock is short of demand and falls when it is long, between a floor and a ceiling, in integer math

a test shows buy_vehicle with kind truck and set_route from a depot to the town market: the truck loads ore at the depot, drives the roads to the market tile, and sells on arrival at the current price, with cash to the Op, ore into the market stock and no attention spent
every cash change is one entry kind in a per-Op ledger (sales, claim fees, build costs, vehicle costs, wages, land deals). A test shows each Op's cash equals its starting cash plus its ledger total

a scenario test from a fresh world with scripted player commands (stake a deposit, roads to it and to the town, depot, harvester, truck) shows the player's cash from ore sales rising within 3 game days
the market and the ledger are in the snapshot and hash, and the determinism tests and pnpm test:slow still match

items.title: Town growth: the town uses ore to grow, and houses appear
acceptance: a sim test shows each game day the town uses ore from its market stock to grow: with enough ore its population and its daily ore demand rise, and with no ore it does not grow
a test shows growth adds houses on free town land, and when the town's land is full it takes adjacent frontier tiles
town growth changes the world only through apply() with the town as the actor (verifier reads the code, and a test shows a house placement comes back as an ok command result)
the market inspector shows population, and the Playwright smoke on a test server where ore was delivered shows more houses than at the start (screenshot pair, verifier opens both)
the determinism tests and pnpm test:slow still match
README How to play says the town grows when it gets ore

items.title: Rival reflex AI: the rival runs the same ore loop through apply()
acceptance: the rival's reflex AI lives in packages/sim, runs every tick and acts only by calling apply() with the rival's Op id under the same costs and attention as the player (verifier reads the code)

the rival reflex decides only from what the rival could see as a player would (its own Op, the map, the public market and parcels) through one view function in packages/sim. A test shows changing the player's cash, cargo or depot stock does not change any command the rival issues
a headless scenario test from a fresh world with no player commands: within 5 game days the rival has staked a deposit, built a depot, run a harvester and a truck, and sold ore to the town

the reflex follows a strategy (which deposit to go for, a sell price floor, whether to expand) that a set_strategy command can change, and a test shows a changed strategy changes the rival's next choice
a 30 game day headless run with the rival reflex holds the invariants: no negative stock or cash, every Op's cash matches its ledger, no Op ever has more than 40 attention points in a day (test)
the 10000-tick determinism test includes the rival, and pnpm test:slow prints the same hash in two processes

items.title: Rival leader Mind: scheduled deliberation on the server, replies as logged commands
acceptance: the rival leader is a named person whose name and personality come from world settings in the server config, and the server schedules their deliberation twice per game day, on events (an offer refused, a wanted deposit taken by someone else) and once soon after the server starts
a server test with a fake backend that takes 5 seconds shows ticks keep arriving while the call is out
a test shows the prompt holds only what the rival could see: its own Op, the map, the public market and parcels. The player's cash value does not appear in it

a server test with the fake backend shows the reply's commands go through apply() as the rival, are stamped and written to the command log, and invalid ones or ones naming another actor are dropped and logged. Restarting the server replays the log to the same hash without calling any Mind
the Mind reply schema covers every Command type, and a contract test round-trips each one and rejects a malformed reply. The fake backend has a rule for the rival leader
backend, binary path and models come from config. Tests run with the fake backend and with claude off the PATH. The governor is on and every call writes a mind_usage row
GET /debug/minds returns the usage rows per agent (server test)

items.title: Land offers: make, accept, reject and expire, with landowners deciding by reflex

a test shows a named landowner decides on an offer by reflex through apply() within one game hour: accept when the price meets their asking price (land value times their price factor), reject when below
offers are in the snapshot, hash and delta, and the determinism tests and pnpm test:slow still match

items.title: Matt plays Ring 1
items.instructions: Open http://laptop.local:7400 on the Mac (http://laptop-ts:7400 away from home).
